strings.name: Aidan Gomez
strings.summary: Raised in Ontario, Gomez studied computing and mathematics at Toronto before research at Oxford. As a Google Brain intern in 2017, he was one of eight authors who introduced the Transformer architecture, a foundation for modern language models. He cofounded Cohere in 2019 to build enterprise language models and applications. His work connects academic research and commercial services, alongside open research and public discussion of model safety and technology governance.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; reviewed November 15, 2026. This is not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Participated in Transformer research and cofounded Cohere, advancing language models from basic research into enterprise applications.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth and upbringing
strings.facts.f1.value: Born in Toronto and raised in Brighton, Ontario, Canada; public sources support only 1996 or 1997 as his birth year.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: University of Toronto bachelor’s in computing and mathematics; Oxford computer science doctorate.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Collaborative Transformer research
strings.highlights.h1.text: One of eight authors of Attention Is All You Need, introducing an attention-based architecture.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Enterprise language models
strings.highlights.h2.text: Cofounded Cohere, extending language models to enterprise search, generation and workflows.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Joining Rivian’s board
strings.timeline.t1.text: Elected director of the electric vehicle company, bringing machine-learning and business experience to governance.
strings.timeline.t2.title: TIME100 AI recognition
strings.timeline.t2.text: Listed among influential AI figures for Transformer research and building Cohere.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Cohere launches open research
strings.timeline.t3.text: The company launched Cohere For AI, later advancing open science as Cohere Labs.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Cofounding Cohere
strings.timeline.t4.text: Founded an enterprise AI company with collaborators including Nick Frosst and Ivan Zhang.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Beginning Oxford doctoral research
strings.timeline.t5.text: Studied machine learning under Yarin Gal and Yee Whye Teh.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Publishing the Transformer paper
strings.timeline.t6.text: Introduced Transformer with seven other authors, demonstrating attention-based machine translation.
strings.timeline.t7.title: FOR.ai research collaboration
strings.timeline.t7.text: Organized collaborative machine-learning research as part of his research-community work.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Google Brain internship
strings.timeline.t8.text: Joined a research team while studying at Toronto, gaining experience with large neural networks.
